changes.rationale: The closed gap's resolution record was xtask/tests/ceremony.rs, which this task deletes. Its three pinning tests moved to xtask/tests/artifacts.rs: handoff_reads_the_branchs_commits_from_a_pull_request_merge unchanged, and the partial-handoff order and placeholder checks inside a_standard_task_owes_a_brief_before_code. The resolution and next_action name the new file and tests; state and requirements are unchanged and the gap stays closed against task-artifacts.

Remove page machinery the evaluation found does not pay (docs/EVALUATION.md, Pages on product tasks). Gone: the full tier and its eight pages, the reader rule, the review-and-rewrite loop, the verdict log and task-artifact verdict (xtask/src/router.rs and handover.rs deleted, brief.rs added for task-artifact next), the reviewer agent in .claude/agents and .codex/agents, and the review-artifact skill, which leaves CEREMONY_SKILLS in transitions.rs and scripts/agent-hook.sh. What a task could be asked to do shrinks; nothing a task is still asked to do is checked less. A standard task's brief keeps its stylesheet check, text floor, before-code commit order at handoff and completion, the pull-request head handling, the edit guard and the author's write limit. The small tier's path gate, receipts, the archive manifest and the stop hook are unchanged. One reading changes: a record below schema 7 owes nothing and cannot claim, where a schema 6 record used to owe eight pages; no such record is left in the tree, and review_errors asks any claimant for schema 7. The reader value and three prompt names are accepted and ignored so the five records already committed still parse. The author hook no longer special-cases reviews.json because nothing writes it. harness/readiness.json drops 33 tests that no longer exist and lists 10 that replace them. showcase/full-ceremony names the last commit with the removed code.
